lessons.title: 1. For Loops & `range()`
lessons.description: `for item in collection:` iterates over items. `range(n)` generates numbers from 0 to n-1. Calculate the sum of squares up to n.
learning_objectives: Iterate using for loops and range()

lessons.title: 2. List Comprehensions & `enumerate()`
lessons.description: List comprehensions offer a concise syntax for transforming lists: `[x * 2 for x in lst if x > 0]`. `enumerate(lst, start=1)` yields index and item pairs.
learning_objectives: Build list comprehensions and use enumerate

lessons.title: 3. Making the Grade (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Organize student test scores using loops, range(), enumerate(), zip(), and list comprehensions.
learning_objectives: Iterate over lists using for loops and list comprehensions
Filter and format collection items dynamically

lessons.title: 4. Discount Price Applier (Practice)

learning_objectives: Apply list comprehensions to price transformations
